       SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS revenue,

JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS total_rev
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
) t
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY p.category
LIMIT 100
